column2: Biobank Biosample and Data Integration Metadata Schema

The Biobank Biosample and Data Integration Metadata Schema extends the MOLGENIS FAIR Genomes framework to standardise how biobank catalogues describe biological samples and their associated large-scale datasets. It links donor profiles, consent, and biospecimen records directly to multi-omics and imaging data using established ontologies. This structured approach facilitates seamless sample discovery, data harmonisation, and metadata exchange across biobank networks.
